_comment: CarbonShift solver battery test configuration (Rust nshift binary only).
_phases_comment: Each phase is independently toggled by leaving its content list(s) empty: DP runs only if both batch_sizes AND infeasibility_modes are non-empty; online runs only if online_strategies is non-empty; offline runs only if additional_strategies is non-empty. See tests/battery/multiple_runs.py for phase-aware parameter grids that avoid redundantly re-running phases a given knob doesn't affect.
_online_batch_sizes_comment: Batch sizes swept ONLY by online_strategies, independent of the DP phase's batch_sizes above. Omit to fall back to batch_sizes. greedy_singleton always forces N=1 regardless of this list.
_runtime_knobs_comment: Runtime knobs below mirror rust/src/config.rs; omit any of them to fall back to that file's Config::default() values. rollback_max_consecutive/max_batch_solver_parallelism affect DP and greedy_singleton only; online_swarm_mode affects bandit/ant_colony only (see multiple_runs.py sensitivity matrix).
